queries_run: AI accelerator power delivery 800V vertical power delivery alternative competitor Vicor 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明電源系統產業競爭激烈、技術變動快、產品快速過時，成熟產品有價格侵蝕；公司策略押注差異化 Advanced Products，並稱無法保證新產品獲客戶接受。
findings.excerpt: The power system industry and the industries in which many of our customers operate are characterized by intense competition, rapid technological change, quickened product obsolescence, and price erosion for mature products, each of which could have an adverse effect on our results of operations.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到具名且有量化的替代技術來源；競品（MPS、Infineon、Empower/ADI 傳聞）與 800V 架構僅見聚合站摘要，未取得可逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: 聚合文章稱 Vicor、MPS、Infineon 皆推垂直／封裝上供電設計；並有 ADI 傳聞以約 15 億美元收購 Empower（未證實）。
Vicor Q1 2026 電話會議稱競品方案電流密度不足，並反駁 800V 轉 6V 匯流排架構。
clues.source: Yahoo Finance Vicor Q1 earnings call highlights
